title: Ru-loaded C12A7:e− electride catalyst performance for ammonia synthesis (Supporting Information)

metal_loading.location: SI Supplementary Figure 1 caption and SI Supplementary Figure 5 caption describe the catalysts as various 1 wt% Ru-loaded catalysts

loading.location: SI Supplementary Figure 1 caption and SI Supplementary Figure 5 caption

h2_n2_ratio.location: SI Supplementary Table 1 footnote a,b states H2:N2 = 3:1

rate.location: SI Supplementary Table 1, Catalytic activity column '(mmol g-1 h-1)'

records.notes: The same row also reports surface area = 1.0 m2 g-1 and surface-area-normalized catalytic activity = 1.82 mmol m-2 h-1; Ea = 49 kJ mol-1.

extraction_notes: Only the Ru/C12A7:e− catalyst requested under 'Catalyst names used for this paper' was extracted. SI Figures S1b, S4, S5 and S6 plot ln[r] rather than r; the underlying NH3 synthesis rates are not printed directly in the SI figure text, so those plotted points were not converted/extracted. SI Figure S6 also includes D2 isotope data, which were not extracted as H2/N2 ammonia synthesis records. Characterisation, isotopic N2 exchange, TPA, pathway schematics and DFT figures were out of scope.
